title: phyllanthus indo-myanmarensis var. puberulus
intro: Phyllanthus indo-myanmarensis var. puberulus, commonly known as the lesser Indian gooseberry or phyllanthus, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia and China. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and enhancing immune system response. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus indo-myanmarensis var. puberulus include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-viral agent, as well as having hepatoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
